label: knows a guilty prisoner was executed
note: Every colonist when a prisoner who harmed the colony in the last 24 hours is executed. Not for Psychopath, Bloodlust or Cannibal colonists (Mood.cpp).

label: knows a prisoner was executed
note: Every colonist when any other prisoner is executed. Not for Psychopath, Bloodlust or Cannibal colonists.

label: knows someone was organ-murdered
note: Every colonist when an organ is taken from a prisoner or other stranger. Not for Psychopath, Bloodlust or Cannibal colonists. The wiki's Memory Misc page says -5 for 8 days, its Death page -6 for 6 days; the second is used.

label: knows a colonist's organ was harvested
note: Every other colonist when an organ is taken from a colonist. Not for Psychopath or Bloodlust colonists.

label: my organ was harvested
note: The colonist an organ was taken from.

label: enjoyed an organ harvest
note: A Bloodlust colonist when an organ is taken from someone else.

label: captive
note: Held in a prison cell (C22). Lowers the prisoner's mood, so wardens' talks work a little worse.

label: was captured
note: The prisoner, when it is laid in its cell (C22).

label: someone talked to me
note: The prisoner, after a warden's talk (C22).

label: night owl
note: Half the Night owl trait's `moodAwakeAtNight` (16): the full numbers broke the colony scenario. Night hours are MoodRules `nightHours` (ours).

label: greedy
note: Half the Greedy trait's `moodWithoutBedroom` (-8): no owned bed in a room whose role is Bedroom.
